description.fun: Lotad floats across ponds under a lily-pad leaf and sometimes gives smaller Pokémon a ride on it, and the leaf repels dirt so well that it stays clean even after ferrying muddy passengers. It's too heavy to live on land, so it only ventures ashore to look for clean water. Its design blends a lily pad with the kappa, a Japanese water spirit with a dish on its head.
description.guide: A small Water- and Grass-type Pokémon with a lily-pad leaf on its back, which it uses to float. It lives in clean ponds and lakes. It evolves into Lombre at level 14, which evolves into Ludicolo with a Water Stone.
description.tagline: A lily-pad ferry that gives smaller Pokémon a ride

description.fun: Lombre is a prankster: it tugs on fishing lines from underwater, then pops up to startle the angler. Covered in a slimy film that's unpleasant to touch, it's sometimes mistaken for a human child, and a Kitakami legend says it once was a mischievous one. Its lily-pad hat and red bill also give it the look of a mariachi in a sombrero.
description.guide: A Water- and Grass-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Lotad line, with a sombrero-like lily pad on its head. It is nocturnal and mischievous, and feeds on moss in riverbeds. It evolves into Ludicolo when exposed to a Water Stone.
description.tagline: A sombrero-hatted river prankster that tugs on fishing lines

description.fun: Ludicolo's body makes energy from cheerful rhythms, so festive music powers it up until it bursts into dance, fearless of any foe; it's even drawn to the sound of children laughing on hikes. Part pineapple, part duck and part kappa, it looks like a dancing mariachi. Its name plays on 'ludicrous' and 'ludic', meaning playful.
description.guide: A Water- and Grass-type Pokémon, the final form of Lotad, that is energised by cheerful music and dances. It looks like a mix of a pineapple and a duck under a lily-pad sombrero. It evolves from Lombre with a Water Stone.
description.tagline: A pineapple-duck that dances whenever it hears a happy tune
